summary: Read the currently configured Node process exit code, preserving undefined before explicit/implicit assignment.

semantics.value_types: integer, integer string, null, or undefined according to modern Node API state
semantics.effect: does not itself terminate the process

caveats: Do not map undefined to integer zero on read; zero and undefined are observably different JS values.

tests.name: normal default
tests.input: const x = process.exitCode; x === undefined || x === null || Number.isInteger(Number(x))

tests.name: edge unset state is undefined
tests.expected_behavior: prints true at ordinary startup before an exit code has been set; the helper must not collapse unset to numeric zero
